propositions: Dependabot PR #131 on navapbc/rebar proposes five package updates: botocore 1.43.70→1.43.72, genai-prices 0.1.2→0.1.3, json-repair 0.63.1→0.63.2, mypy 2.3.0→2.3.1, and ruff 0.16.2→0.16.3.
GitHub blocks direct PR merges to main; all changes must flow through Gerrit, requiring the PR to be re-authored as a Gerrit change for landing.

Bumping mypy and ruff (the typecheck and lint gates) can surface new findings; any newly-surfaced issues must be fixed in code without suppression pragmas (#noqa, #type: ignore), or the upgrade must be split and reported if blast radius is large.
The complexity baseline file must remain unmodified; newer ruff versions may score functions differently, and the ratchet enforces shrink-only behavior.
Upon Gerrit landing and mirror sync, dependabot auto-closes the PR when it detects the changes on main; manual closure is a fallback only if auto-close does not occur within a reasonable window.
